# Iruz Labs

> Iruz Labs is an Artificial Agents as a Service (AAaaS) company. It builds and
> operates squads of specialized AI agents that execute real work in revenue,
> operations, and customer care — with human supervision and enterprise SLAs.
> Multi-agent orchestration, not a self-serve SaaS tool.

Iruz Labs deploys three agent squads:

- **Revenue Squad** — qualifies leads, prioritizes opportunities, books
  meetings, and follows up until pipeline is ready to close. Omnichannel
  (WhatsApp, email, SMS, voice), used in Real Estate and Healthcare.
- **Operations Squad** — coordinates tasks, updates internal systems,
  triggers automations, and removes bottlenecks in day-to-day operations.
- **Care Squad** — handles customer support across channels, resolves
  requests, escalates complex cases, and keeps a consistent experience.

Agents connect to Telegram, WhatsApp Business, Instagram Messenger, phone
calls, and Google Calendar, and integrate with existing CRM/business systems.
